name: Crisp elephant-ear fish
summary: A river fish fried crisp, named on the Cồn Phụng lunch list with the puffed sticky rice, the hotpot, the coconut rice, and the coconut shrimp. A recipe was not printed. A price is check on arrival.
origin: Cồn Phụng, on the national rural lunch list.
howToEat: Share it at the garden table on the boat day. The rural article names the fry and does not print a recipe.
A stall price was not printed. The price is check on arrival.
where: The garden table at Cồn Phụng. The Mỹ Tho bank also serves this fish. This plate is the Ben Tre lunch list.
